settings.q: How long do I have to return something?
settings.a: 14 days from the day your order arrives. Items need to be unused and in their original packaging.
Send your return with any tracked service. If something is faulty or we sent the wrong item, we cover the cost.

settings.q: When will I get my money back?
settings.a: Within 5 working days of your return reaching us, back to the card or account you paid with.
The quickest way is to return the item and place a new order for the one you want, so you are not waiting on an exchange.

settings.q: Can I return a racket I have played with?
settings.a: We can only accept rackets that are unused, with the protective film still on the face. Not sure which racket suits you? Ask us before you order.

settings.q: What if my item is faulty?
settings.a: Contact us with your order number and photos of the fault. Your statutory rights are not affected.

settings.q: I paid with Klarna. How do refunds work?
settings.a: Once we process your return, Klarna updates your payment plan and refunds anything you have already paid.
